name: efcc
description: 顯恩堂系統 — EFCC Church Management System (TypeScript WebApp)

scripts.db:seed:local: tsx tests/e2e/seed-dev-accounts.ts --reset > /tmp/efcc-reset-local.sql && pnpm --dir web exec wrangler d1 execute efcc-identity --local --file=/tmp/efcc-reset-local.sql && tsx tests/e2e/seed-dev-accounts.ts --reset-legacy > /tmp/efcc-seed-local.sql && pnpm --dir web exec wrangler d1 execute efcc-identity --local --file=/tmp/efcc-seed-local.sql && pnpm db:seed:disposable
scripts.verify:identity: pnpm --dir web exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts lib/identity/d1-schema.test.ts lib/identity/seeds.test.ts lib/identity/role-hierarchy.test.ts lib/identity/role-handlers.test.ts
scripts.test:workerd: pnpm --dir web exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --exclude 'lib/auth/normalized-authority-c487.test.ts' --exclude 'lib/identity/permission-editor.test.ts' --exclude 'lib/identity/permission-editor-handlers.test.ts' --exclude 'lib/identity/normalized-authority.test.ts'
scripts.verify:precommit: pnpm verify:fast && pnpm test && pnpm verify:identity && pnpm test:workerd && pnpm --dir web test:components
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:precommit && pnpm test:shell-responsive && pnpm test:shell-geometry && pnpm test:role-hierarchy-geometry
scripts.build: echo No root build step; the web app is built and served by the Worker (see web/).
